title: The Confidence Score: a New Measure on Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2611.05528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Across a wide range of applications, kernel measures are used to tune hyperparameters, select among candidate kernels, and assess the suitability of kernels for specific learning tasks. For classification, kernel measures are used to predict which kernels may produce accurate kernel classifiers. Many existing kernel measures, such as alignment to the ideal kernel, are designed to reward kernels which captures all samples from the same class as similar. While effective in many settings, this requirement is unnecessarily restrictive for classification, where classes may exhibit substantial internal structure. In this work, the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure, is proposed. Unlike alignment-to-the-ideal kernel measures, the Confidence Score measures the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and that ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores. translated_title: 置信度分数：一种新的核度量方法
translated_abstract: 在广泛的应用场景中，核度量被用于调整超参数、在候选核中进行选择，以及评估核对于特定学习任务的适用性。对于分类任务，核度量被用于预测哪些核可能产生准确的核分类器。许多现有的核度量方法，例如与理想核的对齐度，旨在奖励那些将同一类别的所有样本视为相似的核。虽然这种方法在许多场景中行之有效，但对于分类任务而言，这一要求是不必要的严格限制，因为类别内部可能存在大量的内部结构。本文提出了“置信度分数”，这是一种新的核度量方法。与理想核对齐度量不同，置信度分数衡量的是真实标签的编码与经过核投影后的真实标签之间的对齐程度，从而允许保留类内结构的核获得高分。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为“置信度分数”的新核度量方法，通过衡量真实标签编码与核投影后真实标签之间的对齐程度，使保留类内结构的核也能获得高分，克服了传统理想核对齐度量要求同类样本必须完全相似的局限。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes the "Confidence Score", a new kernel measure that evaluates the alignment between an encoding of the ground truth and the ground truth projected by the kernel, allowing kernels that preserve intra-class structure to achieve high scores, unlike traditional ideal-kernel alignment measures.
